t: From Dunning-Kruger to Deep Research: Riding the AI Wave in SEO
s: This article explores how AI can help overcome cognitive biases like Dunning-Kruger and enable deep research by acting as a 'machine mentor,' accelerating progress and democratizing capability. It advocates for focusing on nuanced value creation and continuous learning in an AI-driven SEO landscape.
sub: AI's role in metacognition and overcoming cognitive biases (e.g., Dunning-Kruger)
The evolution of NLP/ML tools from k-means to LLMs and their practical applications
Connecting continuous learning and adaptability to human nomadic origins and AI's potential
Leveraging nuance, analogy, and deep research for impactful SEO in an AI-enhanced world
